notes: Concord Smelter Mk2 (standard, 4x3, manned): the Mk1 frame (hopper, console, coupling, casting line) with two crucibles, each in one copper coil turn, fed by a long chute off the hopper, and a great deal of cooling pipe: a steel loop with blue coolant bands runs down the right edge, along under the crucibles and up between them. Two spouts pour into the line. Damaged: the pipe between the crucibles has split and vents coolant steam, the right crucible lip is cracked and dribbles, the console bar reads red. Disabled: both melts set into cracked grey cakes, the split pipe hangs open, the chute sags, the line is cold.
